notablePrerequisites: Lingering Tormentor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lingering Tormentor, adding {B/G}.
When Lingering Tormentor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Lingering Tormentor, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
